test(ka-pc r3): sign in through the page again until the list shows

r3-2 measured a race in the test, not the shell: the page's own 'restore' message arrived after the form was
filled and emptied the id field, so the press only said the fields were empty and no login was sent (client.log:
no sign-in at all). A person types again; the test now does too, every few seconds up to 40 s.
